notes: This policy is intentionally fail-closed. Every decoded H3M object record in the Homecoming manifest must match exactly one explicit policy row before any reduced Olden map emission.
The current reduced slice targets map/layer/event proof only. It does not port unit, town economy, reward, pickup, mine, hero, prison, or general visitable mechanics.
A row with action=emit_stub authorizes coordinate/layer emission only when the named runtime requirement exists. It does not authorize native Olden SID guessing.
Rows may include sourceKeys and names selectors. Validation is per decoded source record, not per object id, because object ids such as 98 can cover both primary and non-primary mission records.
